subject: general
question: In 1908 Khudiram Bose along with _________ was involved in throwing a bomb at a carriage believing it to be occupied by Kingsford, the then sitting judge of Muzaffarpur.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prafulla Chaki**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khudiram Bose** along with **Prafulla Chaki** was involved in throwing a bomb at a carriage in 1908.
 
• They believed the carriage to be occupied by **Kingsford**, the then sitting judge of Muzaffarpur.
 
• Khudiram Bose and Prafulla Chaki were both young revolutionaries who were part of the Indian independence movement against British rule.
 
• Their act was aimed at retaliating against the repressive actions of the British authorities.
 
• Unfortunately, the bomb missed its target and instead killed two British women, resulting in severe consequences for both revolutionaries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khudiram Bose** was arrested shortly after the incident and was later sentenced to death. He was executed on August 11, 1908, at the young age of 18.
 
• **Prafulla Chaki** managed to evade capture initially but eventually took his own life to avoid arrest.
 
• Their sacrifice became a significant moment in the history of India's struggle for independence and inspired many young Indians to join the revolutionary movement.
 
• Their story is a poignant reminder of the courage and determination displayed by the freedom fighters of India.
